description: This file defines the FakeEmailService class, which implements email sending functionalities for different environments, primarily for testing or local development. It provides methods to simulate sending emails by logging and printing email details to the console.

classes.name: FakeEmailService
classes.description: A mock implementation of EmailService used for local, development, and testing profiles, which logs email actions instead of sending real emails.

methods.name: sendSimpleMessage
methods.description: Simulates sending a simple email message by logging and printing email details.

methods.name: sendMessageUsingThymeleafTemplate
methods.description: Simulates sending an email using a Thymeleaf template by logging and printing email details.
